steps.note: the shop line is in src/plugins.js, so main.js installed it on its own: nothing is installed by hand here.
a watchdog samples every counter window 4x a second: a window still half under the message box, or still off the frame, in two samples running is a real fault and not an animation frame.

steps.eval: (()=>{ window.__neverCovered = true; window.__neverOff = true; window.__faults = []; let prevC = [], prevO = []; setInterval(() => { const s = __DQ.state().shop; if (!s || !s.open) { prevC = []; prevO = []; return; } const c = s.covered || [], o = s.offscreen || []; for (const id of c) if (prevC.indexOf(id) >= 0) { window.__neverCovered = false; window.__faults.push('covered ' + id + ' at ' + s.stage); } for (const id of o) if (prevO.indexOf(id) >= 0) { window.__neverOff = false; window.__faults.push('offscreen ' + id + ' at ' + s.stage); } prevC = c; prevO = o; }, 250); return 'watching'; })()
